plan.notes: UAF 2026-2027 catalog, B.A. History. Official roadmap transcribed semester-by-semester (120 total, matches catalog). Course titles for roadmap-only codes verified against the UAF course descriptions (COM F300X Communicating Ethics, LS F101X Library Information and Research, MATH F113X Math and Society, ANTH F100X Individual, Society and Culture, ANS F242X Indigenous Cultures of Alaska). Roadmap assumes a minor (department strongly recommends one); minor slots may be electives per advisor. HIST F475/F476 fulfill the baccalaureate capstone; C- or better required in each course. Roadmap is advisory; verify with an advisor.
